# Mapping Specification: SIU_WATCHLIST

**Source file:** `data/raw/SIU_WATCHLIST-improved.jsonl`  
**Data source name:** `SIU_WATCHLIST`  
**Entity type:** Person  
**Generated by:** `mapping_workflow`

The source has 17 PERSON records keyed by `RECORD_ID`. `FEATURES.RECORD_TYPE` supplies
each record's root type. The mapper changes the root source label from `WATCHLIST` to the
registered code `SIU_WATCHLIST`; it does not create child or relationship records.

## Mapping Decisions

- The source supplies parsed person-name parts and separate `NAME_FULL` strings; they never
  co-occur in one record. Keep parsed components together and map full strings separately.
- Some full names use Arabic or Cyrillic script. Preserve their UTF-8 text verbatim; do not
  transliterate or normalize it.
- The source has sparse addresses, identifiers, contact values, and employer values. Map
  them only when present; do not impute missing data.
- Root `CATEGORY`, generic `DATE`, and `STATUS` are metadata, not established entity features.
- The MCP-provided globalization guidance supports UTF-8 and cross-script name comparison;
  preserve source text rather than generating transliterations.
- No source relationships or secondary schemas were found. No records have been loaded.

## Quality Notes

- Quality score is 56.5% (39.5% completeness, 95.3% format consistency, 0.0% duplicate rate).
- One of 17 PERSON records has no name. No values were imputed; ambiguous dates and phone-length
  variations remain as collected in the improved input.
- The analyzer validated all 17 output records. Sparse DRLIC, SSN, PHONE, and EMPLOYER fields
  generated advisory warnings consistent with the source profile.
- Verbatim fidelity passed. The routing report's dropped entries are only the 17 values each of
  `CATEGORY`, `DATE`, and `STATUS`, intentionally preserved as payload.

## Record Type Check

- **Candidates:** 0 of 17 PERSON-typed records (suffix heuristic, Module 5 Phase 1 step 6)
- Decision: none needed; preserve the explicit source `RECORD_TYPE`.

## Example output shapes

Parsed name:

```json
{"DATA_SOURCE":"SIU_WATCHLIST","RECORD_ID":"<source-record-id>","FEATURES":[{"RECORD_TYPE":"PERSON"},{"NAME_FIRST":"<source first name>","NAME_LAST":"<source last name>"}],"CATEGORY":"<source category>","DATE":"<source date>","STATUS":"<source status>"}
```

Full name:

```json
{"DATA_SOURCE":"SIU_WATCHLIST","RECORD_ID":"<source-record-id>","FEATURES":[{"RECORD_TYPE":"PERSON"},{"NAME_FULL":"<source full name, unchanged>"}]}
```

## Reproducibility

```sh
javac -Xlint:all -d data/mapping/.build \
  src/transform/JsonSupport.java src/transform/transform_SIU_WATCHLIST.java
java -cp data/mapping/.build TransformSiuWatchlist \
  data/raw/SIU_WATCHLIST-improved.jsonl -o data/mapping/SIU_WATCHLIST_output.jsonl
```
